This '''female Trainer''' is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP248|One Trick Phony!]].''

She battled {{Ash}} with her {{p|Smoochum}}, [[nickname]]d Josephine. However, she forfeited the battle after Josephine was knocked to the ground by {{AP|Pikachu}}'s {{m|Quick Attack}}. The Trainer let Josephine rest after the "intense battle", and recommended that Ash and {{ashfr}} visit the {{jo|Battle Park}} to practice against more Pokémon and Trainers.
